notes_for_editor: No build year, staffing period or removal date for No. 3 appears in any source read. The 1986 report names only the Olga Fire Tower and is not attributed to No. 3. The built-by and administrator statements come from the FFLOS No. 3 record. The three-tower statement comes from the NHLR entry for Olga No. 2, which does not name the other two. The 1947 Olga-name question in us-wv-olga-no-1 would matter for No. 3 only if its date were before 1947, and no date is given. The brief's coordinates and elevation agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
